newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch NCM insures Turkish heat and power plant.
newsitem.headline: Dutch NCM insures Turkish heat and power plant.

text.p: Dutch credit insurer NCM Holding said on Tuesday it had insured the completion of a combined heat and power plant near the Turkish capital Istanbul.

The plant, with a total value of 227 million guilders, will be built by the Dutch company Thomassen Power Systems BV. The project is partly financed by a 68 million guilder loan provided by Citibank, which is also insured by NCM.
The plant has been insured on a project financing basis, whereby instalments of the loans are paid from the proceeds of the plant. NCM previously insured similar projects in Thailand and Oman.
